• Kliarim Play Store + Google Play sevis + Sevis Fremwok data.

strings.mdKbSmart: • Smat keybox fetch: sekim kiboks bilong nau wantaim Google's revokesen lista (CRL) na traim planti sos inap long em i painim wanpela gutpela kiboks, wantaim wanpela otomatik bekap na wanpela ristat bilong Google sevis. Em i save ron long olgeta tap na i nidim intanet (1-3 minit).
strings.mdKbNet: • Kiboks long netwok: daunlodim wanpela kiboks long ofisel repositori (GitHub) na sevim long /data/adb/tricky_store/keybox.xml. I nidim intanet na i kisim 1-3 minit. Ol i save yusim taim 'smart fetch' i no wok gut o taim ol i senisim 'keybox' long han.
strings.mdRkpDiag: • RKP diagnosis: sekim ol Remote Key Provisioning modules we i stap, sekim TEE attestion certificate version, na soim KmInstallKeybox tul stet. I no senisim wanpela samting — wanpela 'plain device status view'.
strings.mdWvDiag: • Widevine sekim (ritim tasol): soim Widevine level indiketa (L1/L3) long dumpsys, DRM (IDM) ki-fail i stap, na ol samting bilong sistem. I no senisim wanpela samting.
strings.mdRkpManual: • Manual RKP stretim: i ranim sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh manual. I stretim ol hevi bilong atestesen taim otomatik pas i no wok. Olgeta ran i save soim klia sakses/feil lain.
strings.mdRkpFull: • Ful RKP stretim: i ranim sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh ful. Em i save lukautim ol hatpela keis na i save kisim longpela taim. Wanpela klia risal i kamap long pinis.
strings.mdGmsReset: • Reset GMS: rausim Play Store na Google sevis (GMS+GSF) data na kirapim gen divais otomatik. Long strongpela tok tasol — em i no save tatsim ol poto o fail bilong yu.
strings.mdCertify: • Plei setifikesen: sekim RKP setifiket atestesen stet bilong divais na setim gen ol atestesen propeti sapos i gat nid. I no save tatsim data bilong yusa.
strings.mdSoter: • SOTER stretim: stretim Google sevis fremwok (SOTER) hevi we i go wantaim divais atestesen. Yusim long sampela divais we i yusim SOTER na i no Play Integrity.
strings.mdPifApply: • Putim PIF: ranim sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/apply_pif.sh fos. Putim 'fingerprint' yu makim (lokal/advans) na apdetim ol pif.prop/pif.json fail. Wanpela klia risal i kamap long log.
strings.mdPifCheck: • PIF sekim: soim stet bilong ensin we i stap pinis, ol fail bilong fingaprint (custom.pif.prop/pif.prop), na ol log. Sekim tasol — em i no senisim wanpela samting.
strings.mdCanary: • Canary apdet: i ranim sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/falcon_update_pif.sh -m. Kisim nupela rilis bilong Canary Engine long meksua olsem em i ken wok wantaim ol RKP setifiket (Februeri 2026).
strings.mdEngineDiag: • Ensin diagnosis: sekim TrickyStoreOSS stet (pid, logs), ol kiboks fail (i wok o yusa), tru o giaman divais fingaprint, target.txt, security_patch.txt, RKP ki. Diagnostik soim tasol.
strings.hintKbSlots: Modul i save menesim tupela kiboks slot: namba wan (tabu, i no bin rausim) na namba tu (bekap). Dispela tab i soim wanem slot i wok, senisim preferens, o promotim sekenderi i go long praimeri sapos yu askim — wantaim ol bekap na ful log.
strings.mdIntegrityDiag: • Integriti daignosis: sekim TEE ki impot, laibreri injeksen insait long kistore2, revokesen status (CRL), proteksen-list kavrej na RKP stet. Ritim tasol — em i no senisim wanpela samting.
strings.confirmIntegrityFix:
🔧 Seif re-apply:

• Proteksen lista i kamap gen long olgeta ap we yu instalim.
• Ol i putim gen 'custom-ROM compatibility layer'.
• Ol i putim gen 'active keybox'.
#000##000# sevis kirap gen.

Nogat wanpela samting i lus na ol i no tatsim namba wan kiboks.

Go het?
strings.mdKbSlots: • Ol kiboks slot: i soim stet bilong ol praimeri na sekenderi slot na senisim ol samting yu laikim namel long ol. Praimeri (/data/adb/falcon/keybox.xml) i save stap oltaim na ol i no save rausim. Long promotim sekenderi i go long praimeri i nidim klia konfemesen.
strings.confirmKbSlotsPromote:
⬆️ Promotim sekenderi slot i go long praimeri:

• /data/adb/falcon/keybox2.xml i kamap praimeri slot konten.
• Ol i sevim praimeri bilong nau olsem bek-ap pastaim long ol i senisim.
• Nogat wanpela samting i lus — operesen i ken senis.
strings.confirmKbSlotsClear:
🧹 Kliarim namba tu slot:

• /data/adb/falcon/keybox2.xml bai ol i rausim.
• Ol i no tatsim namba wan slot.

Go het?

• Sekim kiboks bilong nau agensim Google lista bilong rausim (CRL).
• Traim planti sos inap long painim wanpela klinpela kiboks.
• Otomatik bek-ap + stat gen #000## sevis.

strings.confirmRkpManual:
Givim gen RKP ki:

• Nogat data o kiboks fail i lus.
• Rebootim fon bihain.

Go het?
strings.confirmRkpFull:
Ful ripea:

• Re-provisen RKP + stat gen Google sevis.
• Divais i stat gen otomatik (i no gat wanpela samting i lus).

Go het?
strings.confirmGmsReset:
Stat gen Google sevis:

• GMS + Play Store + GSF — stat gen tasol.
• Nogat wanpela samting i lus na yu bai NO inap sainim aut.
• Divais i stat gen long otomatik.
strings.confirmRkpForce:
Fosim re-provisen (Red Magic):

• Long ol divais we i no tingim 'leaked keybox'.
• I wok maski ol ki i stap gut.
• Nogat data i lus.

Go het?
strings.confirmCertify:
Fosim Play Store setifikesen:

• Kliarim tasol 'Store cache' — akaun bilong yu i no gat wanpela samting i kamap.
strings.confirmSoter:
SOTER repair:

• Statim gen vendor.soter sevis.
• Kliarim SOTER seva data tasol.

Go het?
strings.confirmPifApply:
Putim fingaprint (PIF):

• Senisim custom.pif.prop na putim i go insait long ensin rot.
• Yu mas kirapim gen bihain.

Go het?
strings.confirmCanary:
Apdetim Canary fingaprint:

• Daunlodim laspela ofisel Canary fingaprint long Google.
• Sinkim sekyuriti patch + kirapim gen Google sevis (no ken rausim).

⚠️ Nidim intanet (1-3 minit). Kontinu?
